title: Mr Bloom reviewed the nails of his left hand, then those of his right hand
html_source: When Bloom is faced with some inner turmoil, in this case seeing his wife’s lover, he seeks comfort in the objectivity of the physical world. Blazes Boylan, one could argue, challenges Bloom’s existence as a husband. By regarding something trivial like the nails on each of his hands, Bloom is trying to remember who and what he is.
